verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a government e-services portal like e-FRRO, for example batch submissions by institutions, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only front-door probes: a script-only application shell at the root and a 404 on the legacy entry path. Neither shows any bulk or batch capability, so with no documented support the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
